purpose: operate the network day to day so it stays available, capacity is known, changes are safe and faults are found before users report them
entry_criteria: Network devices and links are inventoried
procedure: Collect link utilization, errors, discards, latency, packet loss and device health, and alert on sustained thresholds and on loss of redundancy, not only on total failure.
Back up device configurations automatically after each change, and compare running with the approved configuration to detect drift.
Make changes through reviewed configuration as code or templates, test in a lab or with a dry run, and prepare a rollback.
Verify redundancy by testing failover of links and devices in a window, and measure convergence time.
Review capacity monthly against growth, and plan upgrades before utilization passes the planning threshold.
Run a security hygiene check: management access limited and logged, unused ports disabled, firmware within support, and access lists reviewed.
acceptance_criteria: Capacity is reviewed with a plan
Management access is restricted and logged

validation.check: diff each device's running configuration with its approved version
disable one uplink in a window and measure time to reconverge
validation.expect: within the agreed time with no lasting loss

failure_modes.detection: Single point of failure for weeks

failure_modes.response: Investigate cable, optics or duplex mismatch

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: Drift detection finds one switch with a manual change to a VLAN; it is reverted from the approved template. A failover test of the primary uplink reconverges in 3 seconds with no lasting loss.
